newsitem.title: USA: United Water to exit environmental testing.
newsitem.headline: United Water to exit environmental testing.

text.p: United Water Resources said Friday it was exiting the environmental testing business and closing its Laboratory Resources Inc subsidiary.
The company said Laboratory Resources, like other companies in the environmental testing industry, have experienced a very difficult operating environment over a prolonged period of time.
It planned to close the New Jersey-based Laboratory Resources operation and sell its laboratory facility in Brooklyn, Conn. to a management-led team by year-end, it said.
United Water said 48 employees will be laid off, while another 24 persons will be offered jobs at the facility in Brooklyn, Conn.
"The environmental testing business has not contributed to our corporate earnings and is not consistent with our corporate strategy," said Chairman Donald Correll.
The company said it would focus on its core water services business.
